roleDescription.OWNER: Full control — manages every member, including other owners, and can assign any role.
roleDescription.ADMIN: Manages members and settings, but can't manage owners or assign the owner role.
roleDescription.MEMBER: Can access and contribute, without management access.

workspaceMembersPanel.emptyMessageDescription: Try a different search or role filter.

projectMembersPanel.emptyMessageDescription: Try a different search or role filter.

workspaceMembersPage.title: Members
workspaceMembersPage.emptyActiveDescription: Members will appear here once they join the workspace.
workspaceMembersPage.emptyPendingDescription: Members you invite will show up here.
workspaceMembersPage.emptyRemovedDescription: Removed members will show up here.
workspaceMembersPage.removeMemberDescription: This will remove the member from the workspace. They'll lose access immediately.
workspaceMembersPage.changeRoleDescription: They'll get <role></role> access to this workspace.
workspaceMembersPage.activateMemberDescription: This will activate the member. They'll get immediate access to the workspace.
workspaceMembersPage.restoreMemberDescription: They'll get access to the workspace again. Their project memberships stay as they are, so each project has to add them back on its own.
workspaceMembersPage.restoreRoleDescription: Removing a member clears their old role, so pick the one they come back with.

projectMembersPage.title: Members
projectMembersPage.emptyActiveDescription: Members will appear here once they join the project.
projectMembersPage.emptyInactiveDescription: Deactivated members will show up here.
projectMembersPage.deactivateMemberDescription: This will deactivate the member on this project. They'll lose access to it immediately.
projectMembersPage.activateMemberDescription: They'll get access to the project again. They have to be an active workspace member for this to work.
projectMembersPage.activateRoleDescription: Deactivating a member clears their old role, so pick the one they come back with.
projectMembersPage.changeRoleDescription: They'll get <role></role> access to this project.
